text:
Maya Li: Quick sync — pushing the APAC SI dry-run to Wed next week. Need final signoff on driver bundles and marketplace image tags for H100/H200, MI300, and Gaudi. @Luis can you confirm lab availability?
Luis Romero: lab ok Wed 09:00 SGT, reserving the H200 cluster and a B200 node for fallback tests.
Priya Shah: thanks. Is the embargo window still strict for the APAC press mention? we might need an exception if certification slips.
Maya Li: embargo remains firm for the joint announcement, but we can do a limited SI-only dry-run mention with partners. legal flagged a short blurb allowance: "SI partners verified — not for press".
Tom Becker: CI-Bot just posted a new compatibility image: `registry.redwood.io/marketplace/gaudi-onramp:2026-03-18-rc3` — includes kernel fixes for milder thermal throttling. @Habana_Rep_Arun please validate.
Habana_Rep_Arun: will validate today. early note: Gaudi firmware v3.2 has a power-profile change; run `--power=balanced` for consistent perf.
NVIDIA_Rep_Scott: Nvidia images also bumped: `nvidia-h200-runtime:1.4.3-rt` — H200 fallback lane verified for 4096 token workloads. sending sample perf logs to the channel.
Priya Shah: FYI ops: we need the compatibility matrix in the dry-run playbook. Suggested fields: model family, kernel, driver, image tag, known limitations.
Maya Li: agreed — here's a minimal snippet for the runbook to avoid last-minute asks:
```
compatibility_matrix:
  - model: h100
    driver: nvidia-driver-535
    image: nvidia-h100-runtime:2.1.0
    notes: no fw updates required
  - model: h200
    driver: nvidia-driver-540
    image: nvidia-h200-runtime:1.4.3-rt
    notes: use fallback lane for >4k tokens
  - model: mi300
    driver: amd-ml-driver-2.0
    image: amd-mi300-runtime:0.9.2
    notes: quantized kernels enabled
  - model: gaudi
    driver: gaudi-kernel-3
    image: registry.redwood.io/marketplace/gaudi-onramp:2026-03-18-rc3
    notes: set power=balanced
```
Maya Li: we should also call out the SI handoff checklist items: data obfuscation banner, KMS envelope test, & console RBAC scoped to partner org.
Luis Romero: I'll prep the lab checklist and mock customer accounts. Can someone own the KMS test?
Priya Shah: I can own KMS and RBAC tests. will create two test keys and a burn policy.
Tom Becker: CI-Bot will run the smoke harness after images are staged. posting results to this thread. current plan: smoke (10min) -> perf (1hr) -> long-run (4hr) where we test KV cache warmups and batching.
NVIDIA_Rep_Scott: quick ask from NVIDIA: can we reserve a 30-min band before the dry-run start for firmware patching? avoids surprises.
Maya Li: yes — schedule patching window 07:30-08:00 SGT same day, followed by a quick reboot and sanity checks.
Habana_Rep_Arun: noted. we'll bring a firmware rollback artifact if needed.
Priya Shah: last item: marketplace listing draft (ops/marketing) — we need to confirm allowed wording for the SI-only badge. draft: "Verified for Redwood Dedicated SI deployments — not for public press." any objections?
Luis Romero: looks good to me.
NVIDIA_Rep_Scott: ok from our side.
Tom Becker: CI-Bot: test-run scheduled for 2026-03-18T01:00Z (maps to Wed 09:00 SGT). will post a run id when available. :rocket:
CI-Bot: run queued: id=ci-24567, smoke=false -> will toggle on when images are confirmed.
Maya Li: perfect. thanks everyone — next steps: @Priya create the KMS keys, @Luis finalize lab reservations, @Tom stage images and kick CI once vendors ack. I'll update the dry-run doc and ping legal for the SI-only blurb approval.
Priya Shah: on it. expected KMS keys created by EOD tomorrow.
Luis Romero: lab reservations done. sending calendar invites now.
Maya Li: closing — ping here with any blockers. :thumbsup:
